Name: The Stardrop Sarsparilla - Fallout Assets
Author: MrGoodhumor
Description: Some Fallout themed replacements I made a while back combined into a Content Patcher bundle. Currently it replaces the saloon for all four seasons, the bear statue, a few lamps, and some wall art. I may add things/improve the mod but I wouldn't hold your breath lol. Should just require content patcher and should work fine with most mods, it's just swapping out targeted parts of the games furniture file and parts of the spring/summer/fall/winter_town maps.
